Very well prepared but small portions
Dec 2019
Very well prepared and spiced tasty seafood. However, if you are big on big portions, as me, you’ll stay “on your hunger”, as they say in Dutch (if you are ordering lobster and/or crab). A lot of work to be done to get to the meat.

It might have been handy to provide scissors or pliers to open the crab.

Decent setting compared to a lot of other restaurants in the neighbourhood.

And as a Belgian I certainly appreciate the presence of Hoegaarden wheat ale (“witteke”) for a bargain of 60,000 VND (as much as you pay nowadays in a Belgian pub or café).
